name: Google Jules
tagline: Jules is Google's AI coding agent that works asynchronously on your GitHub repository. You assign Jules a task — fix this bug, implement this feature, add tests — and it independently reads the codebase, writes a plan, makes changes across multiple files, and opens a pull request. Unlike interactive coding assistants, Jules operates in the background while you continue other work, returning with a completed PR to review. Powered by Gemini 2.0, it is Google's direct answer to GitHub Copilot Workspace and Devin.
